# First Then Board (first-then.app)

> First Then Board is a free First-Then board that runs in the web browser. It shows two picture cards, "First" a task and "Then" something the child wants, and is made for parents, teachers and therapists who support children with autism, ADHD, speech and language needs, and toddlers. There is no account, and all boards and photos stay on the user's device.

Developer: Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska (Apps for Parents).
Website: https://first-then.app/
Type: web app (not an App Store app). Language: English.
Price: free. No account, no ads.

## What it is

- A First-Then board shows two pictures side by side: First a task, Then something the child wants. Example: "First shoes, then park."
- It makes the day predictable and gives a child a clear reason to start a hard task. It is often the first step before a full visual schedule.
- Used by parents, teachers and therapists for autism, ADHD, speech therapy and with toddlers.
- It opens in the browser on a phone, a tablet or a computer. Nothing to download, no sign-up.

## Key features

- Cards: each card has a picture and a word. The picture can be an icon or your own photo. A card can also be text only.
- Icons: about 80 icons in 5 groups (Routines, School, Food, Play, Rewards), with search. The icons are the device's own emoji.
- Own photos: take a photo with the camera or choose one from the device, then crop it to a square. Photos are made smaller on the device and saved in "My photos" to use again on any card.
- Done: tap the First card when the task is done. It gets a check mark and a short confetti celebration, and the Then card lights up.
- First-Then-Next: an optional third card for children who are ready to see one more step.
- Pairs: prepare several First-Then pairs in a row. The child sees one pair at a time, and "Next" moves to the following pair.
- Several boards: save more than one board, for example Morning, School and Therapy.
- Full screen (child mode): shows only the board, with no editing. Exit by holding the close button for about one second. On iPad the full screen button works in Safari. On iPhone, full screen works only when the board is opened from the Home Screen icon.
- Big text: larger words on the cards.
- Print: print one pair or all pairs as a clean paper board, with icons and photos.
- Backup: export all boards and photos to one file, and import it on another device or browser.
- Add to Home Screen: the board can be added to the Home Screen of a phone or tablet and opened like an app.

## Privacy

- All boards, card words and photos are stored only on the user's device, in the browser's storage (IndexedDB).
- Nothing is uploaded. Photos never leave the device.
- No account, no cookies, no ad networks, no trackers.
- Card words and photos are never sent anywhere.

## Main page

- [First Then Board](https://first-then.app/): the board itself, a short guide on how to use a First-Then board, example pairs, tips for autism, ADHD and toddlers, and an FAQ.

## FAQ

- Is it free? Yes. The board is free in the browser, with no account and no ads.
- Where are my photos stored? Only on your device, inside the browser's storage. They are never uploaded to a server.
- Can my boards get lost? Yes, because they live only in that browser. Clearing the browser data deletes them, and Safari may delete site data after some days without a visit. To protect them, add the board to the Home Screen and export a backup from time to time.
- Can I print it? Yes. Open the menu, choose Print, then "this pair" or "all pairs".
- Is there an iPhone or iPad app? Not yet. First Then Board is a web app that works in the browser on iPhone and iPad.

## Related tools by the same maker

- [Visual Schedule Daily Routine](https://visual-schedule.app/): an iPhone, iPad and Mac app that shows a child's whole day as pictures. The next step when First-Then works well.
- [Token Board: ABA Reward Chart](https://token-board.app/): a token board and reward chart app, good for longer tasks and rewards.
- [Visual Timer for Kids](https://kidstimer.app/): a picture-reveal timer app that shows a child how much time is left.
